items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; modern digital redraw created 2013
items.tradition: Small seal script / Shuowen-style modern vector redraw
items.caption: This modern drawing shows the Shuowen-style seal form of 歲. The transmitted Shuowen analysis is 步 with 戌 as a sound element; it does not settle competing explanations of earlier forms.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 歲, with a compact upper section above a larger, complex lower section.
items.selection_reason: A verified, reusable illustration of the later seal-script form directly relevant to the reviewed component account; the caption distinguishes this transmitted analysis from disputed early formation.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the exact Wikimedia Commons file description page.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph. Exact file pages for the oracle and bronze candidates could not be opened, so they were not selected.
Early forms remain disputed in the inspected paleographic account; this seal-script illustration cannot establish the original formation.
